title: Hydrochlorothiazide and non-melanoma skin cancer
excerpt: FDA approved label changes to hydrochlorothiazide to describe a small increased risk of non-melanoma skin cancer, particularly squamous cell carcinoma, and to encourage patients to protect skin from sun exposure and undergo regular skin cancer screenings.

csc.title: Hydrochlorothiazide skin-cancer counseling
csc.recommendedActionTemplate: For {patient}, counsel on sun protection while taking {medications}, recommend routine skin examination, and document shared decision-making with {prescriber}.
csc.rationale: Hydrochlorothiazide labeling describes increased non-melanoma skin cancer risk and recommends sun protection and regular skin checks.
